issues.where: all the land around the crater
issues.what: the cold blue-grey, low-sun relief of -a with deep blue shadows and fine branching gullies has become a flat warm beige tile of repeated radial ribs; it reads as a different terrain in different light
issues.fix: return to the blue-grey rock with pale ridge crests, deep cool shadows and fine dendritic drainage, lit by a low raking sun

issues.where: the crater rim and lake margin
issues.what: the steep pale cliff wall around the lake is gone, and the golden swirling algae margin with tongues curling into the dark water is now a soft blurred orange ring with no structure
issues.fix: rebuild the pale terraced rim wall and the ochre-gold margin with its swirls and filaments reaching into the lake

issues.where: top right and lower right of frame
issues.what: the gold-rimmed twin lakes, the small dark lake and the blue sea inlet with surf are replaced by one flat smooth oval of blue; the river running into the crater at top left is missing
issues.fix: restore the rimmed lakes, the sea inlet at lower right and the river channel with its delta at the crater edge

issues.where: the terrain in close view (x 4-46%, y 4-46%)
issues.what: the relief breaks into stair-step banding and smeared ridges, with no rock texture
issues.fix: give the ridges sharp crests and real rock and scree texture with no banding

issues.what: white specks float on the water and the wisp of vapour that crosses the lake in -a is missing
issues.fix: take out the specks and bring back the thin vapour wisp drifting off the rim over the water

issues.where: the open sea on the left
issues.what: the dense field of small bright cumulus over the dark sea is gone; the water is empty and smooth, with a few smeared clouds and stray dashed streaks
issues.fix: fill the sea again with scattered popcorn cumulus at the density of -a, and take out the dashed streak artifacts

issues.where: the land mass as a whole
issues.what: the pale grey-blue land with frayed teal shallows and a rust-red pitted plain on the right has become warm beige ridges with an olive-green lowland fringe; the colour, surface and mood are different
issues.fix: move the land back to pale grey-blue rock with rust-red pitted ground at the right and no green growth

issues.where: the large inlet right of centre and the pits on the right
issues.what: the crater-like bay ringed by a frilled white rim is now an open sea arm, and the many dark pits across the rust plain are gone
issues.fix: close the bay into the rimmed crater basin of -a and put the scattered dark pits back across the red ground

issues.what: the three thin wisps curling across the land have become one thick, straight white column
issues.fix: go back to fine, translucent curling vapour trails

issues.where: the central crater and the upper lakes
issues.what: the crater's golden swirled margin has become a brown smudge, and the hazy, rimmed dark basins are flat filled ovals
issues.fix: restore the gold swirl margin, and give the basins soft rims and depth

issues.what: a glowing cyan halo outlines every shore, where -a has soft frayed teal shallows
issues.fix: take out the halo and let the shallows break up irregularly

issues.where: the ribbed ridges on the right
issues.what: the bright pale ribs standing over dark teal lowlands are now low brown ridges on brown ground, so the bones no longer read
issues.fix: make the rib crests bright again and darken the lowlands between them to teal-blue

issues.where: the sea cloud on the left
issues.what: the scattered small bright clouds have become large smeared sheets that swamp the left third
issues.fix: go back to broken small cumulus over dark sea, with only the intended motion blur

issues.where: the island with the crater, and the coastlines
issues.what: the pale grey island fraying into teal shallows is now a brown landmass with hard edges, a cyan halo on the shore and a red-brown plain; the red pitted zone with its pits is lost
issues.fix: bring back the pale grey island, the frayed teal shallows and the red pitted ground with its dark pits

issues.where: the lava points among the ribs
issues.what: the small sharp orange pinpoints have become a soft diffuse orange bloom
issues.fix: keep them small bright points with only a faint local glow

issues.what: the fine curling wisps have become a single thick white column
issues.fix: go back to thin translucent curling trails

issues.what: flat turquoise lake patches appear that are not in -a
issues.fix: remove them, or blend them into the dark teal lowland
